description: Fork of exp587 (1.4471 SoTA, E=384/d_v=64, residual_tph=256 per-layer x6). SINGLE architectural change: REMOVE per-layer residual_lut from every LUTBlock and replace with ONE read_out_lut at the end of the layer stack. read_out_lut = TinyMultiHeadLut(soft) E->D, NAP=6, tph=1536 (6x of exp587's per-layer 256). Total residual_lut params unchanged (1x37.7M vs 6x6.29M), trunk bandwidth unchanged (1x18.87 vs 6x3.15 Mbits = same 18.87 Mbits contribution). Tests whether the 6 distributed D-stream injections matter or whether a single concentrated read-out from the final E embedding is equivalent. If equal: simpler topology, same quality. If better: x_resid as sum-of-6-projections accumulator was wasting capacity. If worse: per-layer D-stream injection is load-bearing. Predicted total ~280M params, 155 Mbits trunk, 558 Mbits total.
